'''Clawbane''', known as '''Clawbane the Indomitable''', was a massive [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] and kept in the beast pit of [[Nem'ro's Palace|his palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Clawbane and several other creatures were unleashed on a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] by [[Suudaa Nem'ro's beast master|Nem'ro's beast master]] in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the hunter, though they were killed.<ref name="House Cleaning" />
